content.title: Water and Sewer Permits
content.summary: Applications for new construction in the City of Woodinville require certificates of available water and sewer services from Woodinville Water District before submitting a development permit. Properties without access to sanitary sewers may need to install on-site septic systems, which require approval from the Seattle and King County Public Health Department.

steps.title: Obtain Certificate of Water and Sewer Availability
steps.text: Request a certificate of water and sewer availability from Woodinville Water District prior to submitting a development permit to the City.

steps.title: Apply for On-Site Septic System Approval (if applicable)
steps.text: If your property is located in an area where sanitary sewers are not available, apply for approval of an on-site septic system from the Seattle and King County Public Health Department. Approval is required for issuance of many building permits.

required_documents.name: Certificate of Water and Sewer Availability
required_documents.description: Certificate from Woodinville Water District confirming availability of water and sewer services for the property.

required_documents.name: On-Site Septic System Approval
required_documents.description: Approval from Seattle and King County Public Health Department for installation of an on-site septic system if sanitary sewers are not available.
required_documents.where_to_get: Seattle and King County Public Health Department
